data.long_meaning: From the Old English elements meru ('mercy') and hlinan ('to hide, protect'). Merilyn may symbolize a compassionate and protective woman, like a mother lion safeguarding her cubs. The name Merilyn carries the meaning “Merciful lynx” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Merilyn usually hope their child will grow to embody merciful lynx and live with faith, good character and purpose.
